scope: The surviving low masonry and Ziyara-i Ibrahim at the Palace of Sultan Mas'ud III archaeological site in Ghazni as seen in June 2010.

references.filename: Palace of Sultan Mas'ud III (northeast of Ghazni).jpg

originalReview.notes: This crop of the June 2010 federal image shows the dark roofless wall fragments, low earth-colored foundations and the small domed shrine above the site.

references.filename: Minaret (left) and Palace (right) of Sultan Mas'ud III (northeast of Ghazni).jpg

originalReview.notes: Wider crop from the same negative showing the palace archaeological mound to the right of the standing minaret and below the surrounding hills.

quallaSearch.notes: Both exact Qualla files are crops of the same June 24, 2010 United States Air Force photograph by Tech. Sgt. James May. Its original DVIDS release declares PUBLIC DOMAIN and matches VIRIN 100624-F-4473M-159 on the Commons parent file. The editorial highlight was excluded.
